invocation_contract.enable: Set AdbDisable DWORD to 0, then restart VM 100.
invocation_contract.recover_daemon: If adb reports 'server didn't ACK', kill only stale adb.exe clients, start bundled adb server, then reconnect.

known_failure_modes: GameLoop ADB client may double-append :5555 if passed host:port in some states; host-only connect works when listener is present.
Stale adb.exe client can wedge daemon startup; terminate stale adb clients and restart server.
Listener can disappear when VM is restarted; verify before connecting.
safety_scope: General emulator administration/diagnostics only. Does not authorize bypassing app integrity, anti-cheat, DRM, or security controls.
